list.name: indicator
list.label: Indicator
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT i.code AS __value, i.name AS __text FROM indicator i JOIN series s ON s.indicator_code = i.code WHERE s.role = 'primary' AND s.geo <> 'BG' ORDER BY 2

list.query: SELECT DISTINCT frequency FROM series WHERE indicator_code = '$indicator' AND role IN ('primary', 'benchmark')

targets.rawSql: SELECT period::timestamptz AS time, value, geo AS metric FROM v_indicator_values WHERE indicator_code = '$indicator' AND frequency = '$freq' AND role IN ('primary', 'benchmark') AND vintage = '' AND origin = 'raw' AND (geo = 'BG' OR geo IN ($geo)) AND $__timeFilter(period) ORDER BY 1

SELECT geo, value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (geo) geo, value, period FROM v_indicator_values WHERE indicator_code = '$indicator' AND frequency = '$freq' AND role IN ('primary', 'benchmark') AND vintage = '' AND origin = 'raw' AND (geo = 'BG' OR geo IN ($geo)) AND value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY geo, period DESC) t ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Bulgaria minus peer, latest common period

targets.rawSql: WITH v AS (SELECT geo, period, value FROM v_indicator_values WHERE indicator_code = '$indicator' AND frequency = '$freq' AND role IN ('primary', 'benchmark') AND vintage = '' AND origin = 'raw' AND value IS NOT NULL), p AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.geo) o.geo, o.period, o.value AS peer, b.value AS bg FROM v o JOIN v b ON b.geo = 'BG' AND b.period = o.period WHERE o.geo IN ($geo) ORDER BY o.geo, o.period DESC) SELECT geo, period, round(bg::numeric, 2) AS bulgaria, round(peer::numeric, 2) AS peer, round((bg - peer)::numeric, 2) AS difference FROM p ORDER BY difference DESC
